stage_order: material-scope filtering and dense Top 18 truncation
per-chunk 2200-character cap and total 12000-character context budget

source_locations.detail: Production history is loaded, rewrite_query is called, and the resulting query is passed unchanged to retrieval.
Fresh conversations have no history and therefore return the original question without an LLM rewrite.
candidate_limit=min(search_top_k_max, max(top_k*3, top_k)); frozen top_k=6 and search_top_k_max=20 produce 18.
The cleaned query is embedded, FAISS is searched, material scope is applied, dense hits are sorted, and the response is truncated to the requested candidate limit.
The index is IndexFlatIP and query search returns inner-product scores.
Dense candidates are deterministically sorted and then filtered by rag_min_score=0.35.
Adjacent chunks from the same material are rejected when substantial overlap is detected.
First pass caps each material at ceil(max_sources/2)=3; second pass backfills in rank order.
Selection stops at Top 6, chunks are capped at 2200 characters, and total context is capped at 12000 characters.
The selected evidence enters grounded generation; answerability and evidence-bound citations are then persisted.

implementation_seam_assessment.current_state: retrieve_sources currently combines candidate generation, thresholding, deduplication, diversity, and context budgeting in one function.
implementation_seam_assessment.required_seam: Expose one ordered CandidatePool between retrieval/fusion/reranking and evidence governance.
implementation_seam_assessment.candidate_pool_interface: build_candidate_pool(query, scope, arm_config) -> ordered candidates with identity and score provenance
implementation_seam_assessment.evidence_governance_interface: govern_evidence(ordered_candidates, frozen_policy) -> final evidence plus rejection reasons
implementation_seam_assessment.implementation_guidance: Extract the existing governance implementation once and call it for all four arms; do not copy it into arm-specific paths.

dense_only.role: Frozen control; reuse run 20260814T052007Z-593cd2ac without rerun.

hybrid.role: Measure lexical complement to dense candidate recall.
hybrid.eligibility_gate: dense_score >= 0.35 OR bm25_rank IS NOT NULL

dense_rerank.role: Measure independent query-chunk ordering on the unchanged dense candidate pool.

hybrid_rerank.role: Measure complementarity; this arm is not presumed best.
hybrid_rerank.eligibility_gate: dense_score >= 0.35 OR bm25_rank IS NOT NULL

candidate_budget.rationale: The production control exposes 18 diagnostic candidates. Keeping every pre-governance pool at at most 18 isolates retrieval method and ordering from recall-depth changes.

candidate_identity.lexical_unit: Exactly the same 442 post-ingestion runtime chunks used by dense retrieval.
candidate_identity.identity_collision_rule: Fail the run; never merge candidates with the same stable_chunk_id but different content hashes.

tokenizer_contract.latin_and_identifier_tokens: Emit contiguous alphanumeric identifiers; preserve underscore, dot, slash, colon, and hyphen inside identifiers and also emit their alphanumeric parts.
tokenizer_contract.cjk_tokens: Emit overlapping CJK character bigrams; emit a unigram only for a one-character CJK run.

bm25_branch.implementation_dependency_status: Not installed and not added in this design-only round; Phase 1 may add an experiment-only pinned dependency after ABALATION_DESIGN_SHA256 binding.

fusion.formula: fusion_score(d) = sum(1 / (60 + branch_rank(d))) over branches containing d
tie_break_order: dense rank ascending with null last
bm25 rank ascending with null last
fusion.rationale: Dense similarity and BM25 scores do not share a calibrated numeric space. RRF uses ranks; k=60 is the value frozen in the original RRF study and is not tuned on the 72 cases.

threshold_contract.placement: After optional reranker ordering and before overlap deduplication.
threshold_contract.dense_candidate_rule: A candidate with dense provenance is dense-eligible only when dense_score >= 0.35.
threshold_contract.bm25_candidate_rule: A candidate in BM25 Top 18 is lexical-eligible by bounded rank; there is no BM25 relevance threshold.
threshold_contract.hybrid_union_rule: Eligible when dense-eligible OR bm25_rank is not null.
threshold_contract.reranker_rule: Reranker score orders candidates only and is never compared with 0.35.
threshold_contract.fusion_rule: RRF score orders candidates only and is never compared with 0.35.

rejected_options.B_NO_RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD: Rejected because it silently removes the frozen dense 0.35 admission policy.
rejected_options.C_NORMALIZED_COMMON_SCORE: Rejected because calibration would require a new tuning experiment and would mix unrelated score semantics.

reranker.placement: After dense retrieval or hybrid fusion and before threshold eligibility, overlap deduplication, document diversity, final Top K, and context budgeting.

input_contract.rationale: Titles and section metadata are not uniformly present across Markdown, text, and PDF chunks; the minimum pair contract avoids a metadata-availability confound.
input_contract.truncation: Preserve the complete query and truncate only the chunk tail when the pair exceeds 1024 model tokens; record truncation telemetry.
input_contract.query_too_long_rule: Fail the case before scoring if the query alone cannot fit with required special tokens.

preferred_model.artifact_size: approximately 2.29 GB repository / 2.27 GB primary safetensors
preferred_model.deployment: CPU-capable through the already-pinned sentence-transformers/transformers stack, but expected to add material latency; Phase 2 must measure it before any LLM run.
preferred_model.selection_rationale: Strong multilingual query-passage scoring, explicit reranker architecture, supports the bilingual technical corpus, and has a commercially usable license. It is a separate scoring model and does not reuse BGE-M3 embedding vectors.

backup_model.languages: 15 languages, including the benchmark's Chinese-English use case
backup_model.deployment: Lower CPU memory and likely lower latency than the preferred 0.6B model; quality on this technical corpus is unverified.
backup_model.selection_rationale: Operationally cheaper multilingual cross-encoder available through the existing sentence-transformers dependency.

reranker.model_switch_rule: The backup is documentation only. Replacing the preferred model, revision, token limit, or score contract requires a new design version and hash before executing any V1 arm.

query_rewrite.behavior: Current production behavior; no hybrid-only query expansion or BM25 keyword rewrite.
query_rewrite.fresh_conversation_effect: No history means no rewrite occurs.

evidence_governance.eligibility_gate: Arm-typed score contract; this is not a unified numeric threshold.
evidence_governance.overlap_dedup: Current _substantial_overlap policy for adjacent chunks in the same material.
evidence_governance.document_diversity: Current two-pass policy: first pass cap 3 per material, then rank-ordered backfill.

citation.pipeline: Current evidence-block validation, deterministic rendering, allowed-source enforcement, and persistence.

score_provenance.null_rule: A score or rank absent for an arm or branch must be null; values must never be synthesized.

retrieval_primary.name: claim_required_evidence_candidate_coverage
retrieval_primary.case_repaired_definition: A target case that lacked complete claim-required evidence in A has all required evidence groups represented in the arm's Top-18 candidate pool.

reranker_primary.name: claim_required_evidence_selected_context_coverage
reranker_primary.case_repaired_definition: A target case that lacked complete selected evidence in A has all required evidence groups in the final governed context.

end_to_end.causal_trace: retrieval change -> candidate/evidence change -> generation output change

latency.quality_cost_report: Report target-case recovery and regression counts beside incremental retrieval/reranker P50 and P95 latency.

execution_isolation.dense_control_execution: Reuse the frozen A artifacts; do not create a new A generation run unless a documented validity audit fails.

hard_reject_conditions: Any frozen Gold, corpus, baseline, target-case-set, model revision, or design hash mismatch.
No positive change on the arm's primary target metric.
Any severe regression among the 33 frozen NO_FAILURE cases: correct answer/refusal becomes incorrect, or a previously supported required claim becomes unsupported.
Any new semantically invalid citation, unsupported factual claim, or answerability error attributable to the arm.
Incomplete telemetry, non-isolated state, execution errors, or unreviewed semantic outputs.
Latency, memory, or operational behavior cannot be measured reproducibly.
advance_to_production_review_requires: Target fixed-case count is greater than target regression count and every target transition is semantically reviewed.
All regressions outside target sets are enumerated; no severe frozen-pass regression exists.
Citation semantic support and answerability do not materially regress.
Retrieval, reranker, selection, total P50, and total P95 latency plus memory cost are reported against A.
The smallest architecture on the quality-latency-complexity Pareto frontier is selected.

minimal_complexity_rules.hybrid: B may advance only for verified candidate-coverage recovery on RETRIEVAL_MISS cases.
minimal_complexity_rules.dense_rerank: C may advance only for verified selected-context recovery; ranking and diversity subgroups must be reported separately.
minimal_complexity_rules.hybrid_rerank: D may advance over B or C only if it fixes at least one target case neither single intervention fixes, while satisfying every hard gate.
minimal_complexity_rules.tie: If quality outcomes are equivalent within reviewed case transitions, choose the lower-latency, lower-memory, lower-operational-burden arm.

production_decision_rule.research_effective_but_not_production_wo: An arm is recorded as technically effective but rejected for production when it improves its target metric yet fails a hard gate, is dominated by a simpler arm, or D shows no complementary recovery beyond B/C.
production_decision_rule.numeric_latency_gate_rationale: No product latency SLO or hardware-normalized reranker measurement exists. Inventing a percentage would bias the gate; production advancement therefore requires explicit human acceptance of the fully reported measured trade-off.
production_decision_rule.final_authority: Production review after semantic comparison; this design never authorizes automatic deployment.

implementation_staging.phase_1: Implement experiment-only Hybrid and Reranker infrastructure plus offline unit tests; bind ABALATION_DESIGN_SHA256.
implementation_staging.phase_2: Run retrieval-only/no-LLM dry runs to validate identity, fusion, reranking, null score fields, rejection reasons, isolation, latency, and determinism.
implementation_staging.phase_3: After Phase 2 passes, execute the three experimental 72-case arms; do not rerun A.
implementation_staging.phase_4: Freeze raw answers, compute machine metrics, perform semantic review, and compare root causes and regressions.
implementation_staging.phase_5: Apply the pre-registered production decision rule.

unavoidable_arm_differences.label: UNAVOIDABLE_ARM_DIFFERENCE
unavoidable_arm_differences.difference: Hybrid arms admit BM25 Top-18 members without applying the dense 0.35 threshold.
unavoidable_arm_differences.reason: BM25 and dense scores are not comparable; lexical admission is rank-bounded and fusion is rank-based.

unavoidable_arm_differences.label: UNAVOIDABLE_ARM_DIFFERENCE
unavoidable_arm_differences.difference: Reranker arms order candidates before the frozen eligibility/dedup/diversity governance sequence.
unavoidable_arm_differences.reason: The experiment tests whether independent relevance ordering changes which evidence survives unchanged governance.

unavoidable_arm_differences.label: UNAVOIDABLE_ARM_DIFFERENCE
unavoidable_arm_differences.difference: B, C, and D require new generation requests while A reuses frozen raw answers.
unavoidable_arm_differences.reason: Retrieval evidence can change generated output; rerunning A would add cost and uncontrolled provider-time variance without changing the control definition.
